tldr: North Node in House 4: growth through home, roots, private safety, family patterns, and emotional foundation.
body: This nodal axis asks the person to develop home, roots, private safety, family patterns, and emotional foundation. The South Node in House 10 shows the familiar life field: status, authority, public achievement, or proving worth through success. The house axis describes where the growth has to become lived, not just understood. The practice is to make the inner foundation strong enough to support the outer life.
business: Growth becomes practical when the person chooses home, roots, private safety, family patterns, and emotional foundation in the concrete house topics of daily life.
shadow: Under stress, the South Node in House 10 can pull the person back toward status, authority, public achievement, or proving worth through success.
policy: Read as a nodal axis: North Node house names the growth field; South Node house names the familiar field. Requires accurate birth time for house placement.
note: Distilled from approved project node source material. Source files were not copied into the repository.
